detailZh: 光照、材质与 GPU 实验

en: Rendering field guide
zh: 渲染指南
detail: Representations, data contracts and the pipeline
detailZh: 场景表示、数据约定与渲染管线 · 英文

en: Explore the live viewer
zh: 探索实时 Viewer
detailZh: 观察真实 STG-Lite 模型 · 英文

en: From photographs to a scene you can move through
zh: 从照片，到可以自由观察的场景
keywords: pipeline Explain what is learned, what is rendered, and why the two use the same forward function. 说清楚模型学什么、渲染算什么，以及为什么二者共用同一个前向函数。

en: Why a Gaussian is a soft brush
zh: 为什么 Gaussian 像一支柔和的画笔
keywords: kernel Build the Gaussian weight from subtraction, division, squaring and an exponential; then understand covariance. 用减法、除法、平方和指数搭出高斯权重，再理解协方差。

en: How a 3D brush lands on a 2D screen
zh: 三维画笔怎样落到二维屏幕上
keywords: camera Derive perspective from similar triangles and see why projecting shape needs a Jacobian. 从相似三角形推透视，理解为什么投影形状需要 Jacobian。

en: How overlapping splats become one pixel
zh: 许多重叠的 Splat 怎样变成一个像素
keywords: composite Compute front-to-back transmittance, explain ordering, and map the result to GPU blending. 算清前到后的透射率、解释排序，并对应 GPU 混合。

en: One direction, three independent color sums
zh: 一个方向，三组独立的颜色求和
keywords: sh Read SH as weighted directional patterns and explain why separate channels produce a colored sphere. 把 SH 看成方向图案的加权组合，解释独立通道为什么能组成彩色球。

en: What the fourth dimension actually changes
zh: 第四个维度到底改变了什么
keywords: time Evaluate an STG-Lite record at a timestamp and distinguish it from deformation and joint 4D Gaussians. 在某个时间求值 STG-Lite，并分清形变与联合四维高斯。

en: Good training starts before the first gradient
zh: 好训练从第一步梯度之前就开始
keywords: data Assemble an image–camera–time training sample and prevent coordinate, resizing and evaluation mistakes. 组成图像—相机—时间训练样本，避免坐标、缩放和评估错误。

en: How a pixel tells a parameter to move
zh: 一个像素怎样告诉参数该往哪改
keywords: gradient Derive a complete scalar gradient and connect its chain rule to the real splat evaluator. 推完一条完整的标量梯度链，再对应真实 Splat 求值器。

en: Watch a model actually learn
zh: 看着一个模型真正学起来
keywords: train Run genuine updates, distinguish forward/backward/optimizer stages, and read what the loss does and does not prove. 运行真实更新，分清前向、反向、优化器，并正确解读损失曲线。

en: Why training sometimes adds or removes Gaussians
zh: 为什么训练有时要增删 Gaussian
keywords: density Distinguish optimizing existing parameters from changing representation capacity, without treating clone/split as exact preservation. 分清调整现有参数与改变表示容量，并理解复制或分裂并不严格保图像不变。

en: A model file is a promise to the renderer
zh: 模型文件是对渲染器的一份约定
keywords: record Trace a trained number through a binary record, activation and shader field; distinguish export from a resumable checkpoint. 把训练数字追踪到二进制记录、激活值和 shader 字段，分清导出文件与训练检查点。

en: Train, export, render—and defend every step
zh: 训练、导出、渲染，并解释每一步
keywords: budget Run the repository’s end-to-end exercise and explain how to integrate and profile its Rust/wgpu render pass. 跑通仓库端到端练习，说清 Rust/wgpu 渲染通道的接入与性能测量。

en: Start with your first pixel
zh: 从一个像素开始搭建
keywords: Create the project, run a known milestone, and name who owns every part of the frame. 建立项目，运行确定的里程碑，说清一帧中每个部分由谁负责。

en: Connect a window to the GPU
zh: 把窗口连接到 GPU
keywords: Initialize both hosts, handle resizing, and follow a frame’s lifetime without confusing a window with a texture. 初始化两个宿主，处理尺寸变化，分清窗口与纹理，追踪一帧的生命周期。

en: Teach the GPU to draw a triangle
zh: 教 GPU 画出第一个三角形
keywords: Connect shader stages, draw calls and interpolation to visible pixels. 把 shader 阶段、draw call、插值与实际像素连接起来。

en: Move numbers from Rust into GPU memory
zh: 把 Rust 中的数字送进 GPU 内存
keywords: Build the Rust/WGSL data contract and draw one quad per instance. 建立 Rust/WGSL 数据约定，让每个实例绘制一个四边形。

en: Turn a rectangle into a soft splat
zh: 把矩形变成柔软的 Gaussian
keywords: Implement Gaussian falloff, premultiplied alpha and order-dependent composition. 实现高斯衰减、预乘透明度以及依赖顺序的合成。

en: Give the splat a camera and a 3D shape
zh: 为 splat 加上相机与三维形状
keywords: Connect world/view/clip coordinates, the projection derivative and a screen-space ellipse. 打通世界、观察、裁剪坐标，连接投影导数与屏幕椭圆。

en: Load a real model without guessing its meaning
zh: 明确数据含义，再加载真实模型
keywords: Decode a specific model contract, upload persistent records, and render the pretrained fixture. 解码具体模型约定，上传常驻记录，渲染预训练数据。

en: Make time an explicit rendering input
zh: 让时间成为输入
keywords: Evaluate motion and temporal opacity, then keep camera, sort and playback synchronized. 计算运动与时间透明度，让相机、排序及播放保持同步。

en: Trace one learned number all the way to a pixel
zh: 追踪一个学到的参数，直到最终像素
keywords: Connect capture, optimization, export and runtime without confusing a viewer with a trainer. 连接采集、优化、导出与运行时，分清 viewer 和训练器的职责。

en: Integrate one pass into two hosts—and your engine
zh: 让同一个 pass 接入两个宿主和自研引擎
keywords: Define a reusable rendering boundary, then account for depth, color and device ownership in an existing engine. 定义可复用渲染边界，并在现有引擎里处理深度、色彩与设备所有权。

en: Measure first, then design a compute rasterizer
zh: 先测量，再设计 compute 光栅器
keywords: Separate bottlenecks and connect today’s quad renderer to a future tile-based backend. 区分性能瓶颈，并把当前 quad 渲染器连接到未来的 tile 后端。

en: Prove it works, then ship and explain it
zh: 验证、交付，并把它讲明白
keywords: Produce repeatable evidence, a reviewable deployment and a concise engineering explanation. 形成可复现证据、可审阅部署以及清楚的工程讲解。

en: A color is not a material
zh: 颜色不等于材质
keywords: Separate camera motion, light motion and material changes. 分清转相机、转光源与改材质。

en: Count the light, one direction at a time
zh: 把每个方向的光加起来
keywords: Build the rendering equation from multiplication and addition. 从乘法与加法搭出渲染方程。

en: Build a moving highlight
zh: 做出会移动的高光
keywords: Read every factor in the actual GGX shader. 读懂实际 GGX shader 的每一个因子。

en: Send light through the splat pipeline
zh: 让反射光走完 splat 管线
keywords: Follow two GPU passes and their color spaces. 走通两个 GPU pass 与颜色空间。

en: Use SH for light, not just appearance
zh: SH 不只表达外观，也能表达光照
keywords: Understand lighting coefficients, transfer and TranSplat. 理解光照系数、传输与 TranSplat。

en: Learn materials without learning the wrong thing
zh: 怎样学习材质，避免把光学错
keywords: Trace inverse rendering from observations to a relightable asset. 从观测数据走到可重打光资产。

en: Add time without breaking the light
zh: 加入时间，别让光照出错
keywords: Derive inverse-transpose normals and dynamic visibility. 推导逆转置法线与动态可见性。

en: Bring relighting into the engine
zh: 把重打光接进引擎
keywords: Separate working capabilities from the next implementation milestones. 区分已实现能力与后续实现里程碑。

en: Follow one pixel
zh: 追踪一个像素
detail: Change inputs · inspect every intermediate value
detailZh: 改变输入，观察每一步的数值

en: Training, step by step
zh: 逐步模拟训练
detailZh: 渲染 → 损失 → 梯度 → 更新

en: Spherical harmonics in 3D
zh: 三维球谐函数
detail: SH · RGB channels · rotate the basis lobes
detailZh: SH · RGB 通道 · 旋转观察基函数

en: GPU milestones
zh: GPU 里程碑
detail: Eight stages in the shared Rust/wgpu renderer
detailZh: 共享 Rust/wgpu 渲染器的八个阶段

en: Move the light
zh: 移动光源
